evidence_class: Scoped fixture launch grants from LaunchAuthority, fakeredis, fixture clock; no live rollout. Live G3 qualification is separate.
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.accounts.AccountCapacity.reserve(token, cap, ttl_ms): one Redis WATCH/MULTI transaction adds a reservation with an expiry only while the account's live reservations and occupancies are below cap; account, seat, execution and generation come from the validated launch grant; ttl_ms is at most the launch grant lifetime (MAX_TTL_SECONDS * 1000); a full account refuses account_full and counts the conflict

AccountCapacity.occupy(token, scope, session_id): converts the caller's reservation to occupancy only while the SV2-ACC-01 fleet registry holds a live record of the same execution and generation; the registry hash is watched
AccountCapacity.release(token): frees only the slot held by the caller's execution and generation; anything else is stale_generation
AccountCapacity.freeze, thaw, frozen, reconstruct(registry, registration): the rollback controls

hooks.context.account_sessions.fleet_held(environ) and sessions_by_account: the per account counts init-agent routing and the swarm capacity rows read now add fleet reservations and remote occupancies while distributed launches are on, and fail open on a Redis error

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards in the linked CI run
supported_versions.coordination: SV2-CTL launch grants (LaunchAuthority registration), execution generations, SV2-ACC-01 fleet registry records
supported_versions.compatibility: With AGENTIHOOKS_RUNTIME_BACKEND unset, local, or disabled, sessions_by_account reads no Redis and counts /proc exactly as before (INV-R11)

states.observed: Local /proc session counts and registry records; a suspect record still holds its slot, a closed or missing one does not
states.accepted: A request whose launch grant validates for this swarm, execution and generation
states.committed: Redis WATCH/MULTI transaction on the account hash (and the swarm's fleet-sessions hash for occupy)
states.externally_verified: None; no live distributed launch issues grants yet

measurements.dimension: Each test has its own fakeredis store built from account-capacity.json; counts are per account fixture

failure_fixture: tests/fixtures/swarm_v2/account-capacity.json with the racing store wrapper in tests/test_swarm_v2_accounts.py (Racing commits the other controller's reservation between read and commit; Ambiguous loses the reply after commit)

rollback_rehearsal.action: freeze() refuses new distributed reservations; reconstruct() rebuilds this swarm's occupancy from current confirmed registry records and launch registrations, drops unconfirmed occupancies, keeps reservations and other swarms' rows
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: Registry records and launch registrations are the authority and are only read; other swarms' account rows are byte-equal before and after

remaining_limitations: No production path issues launch grants yet, so nothing calls reserve, occupy or release in a live launch; the distributed spawn wiring is its own follow-up task. The package stays incomplete until that path reserves, occupies and releases.
reserve accepts any integer cap from its caller; the controller supplies it with the worker's grant, and SV2-ACC-03 owns the quota source of that cap
A closed execution whose launch grant is still valid can take a reservation until the grant expires (at most 900 s); occupy refuses it
Fleet slots are counted under the grant's account name, which must match the AH_CC_TOKEN_<slug> routing slug
